In accordance with Regulation 9(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, the Petitioner was required to file an application to determine the tariff for the 2019-24 period by 31.10.2019. However, the Petitioner filed the instant Petition on 9.6.2023. It is pertinent to mention that the Commission, in its order dated 28.10.2019 in Petition No. 331/MP/2019, relaxed the provisions of the 2019 Tariff Regulations for filing of the tariff Petitions. Accordingly, considering the Petitioner’s submissions for condonation of delay in filing this Petition, we condone the delay. However, we are of the view that the Petitioner is not entitled to carrying costs in this case until 9.6.2023, i.e., the date of filing the Petition, as the Petitioner did not file the instant Petition within the specified timeline. 15.
